query:
INSERT INTO page_updates (page_id, "update", author_id, created_at)
           SELECT $1, u.body, u.author_id, u.created_at
           FROM UNNEST($2::bytea[], $3::uuid[], $4::timestamptz[])
               WITH ORDINALITY AS u (body, author_id, created_at, n)
           ORDER BY u.n
           RETURNING seq
